# B4.1 real frozen fixture

This fixture contains 20 normalized PubMed article records copied from the locally
captured snapshots used for the B4 smoke runs: 10 acyclovir/herpes-zoster records
and 10 losartan/hypertension records. It is an offline replay fixture; it does not
constitute a clinical gold standard. Source provenance remains in each article's
PMID, DOI, PubMed URL, and normalized metadata.
